Jing: quick dump from today's TP perf pass — seeing a sharp latency cliff around ~48KB message size when the runtime picks NCCL ring rendezvous during microbatching. p99 spikes, tails get worse. attaching traces and a short flame.
Mateo: which nccl version + topology? any kernel changes recently? :thinking:
Jing: infra is on NCCL 2.12, HW is 8xA100 (NVLink mesh), topology pinned to zone-a. no recent kernel changes in mainline, only heuristic tweaks to batching last week.
Priya: does the trace show compute overlap or pure comm saturation? small-message patterns can kill overlap.
Jing: trace snippet:
```
[trace] step=142 allreduce start=0.0021s size=52KB alg=ring chunk=32KB
[trace] gpu0 idle during chunk2; cpu enqueue backlog=23
[summary] comm_time=11.2ms compute_overlap=0.18 p99=63.4ms
```
Mateo: hmm cpu enqueue backlog + many small fragments from kvcache could explain it. kvcache materialization splits prefixes into 6-12KB ops right?
Jing: yes — observed that when caching prefixes we end up sending ~8x smaller messages vs baseline.
Alex: can we try forcing tree algorithm for <128KB payloads? tree gives lower latency for small msgs at the cost of bandwidth efficiency for large ones.
Mateo: agree. also try tuning NCCL chunk size and fragment thresholds. quick A/B: tree for <=128KB; ring for >128KB.
Jing: applied a runtime heuristic patch to stage: `if payload < 131072 -> prefer_tree = true` — quick bench results on staging:
- p50: 12.0ms -> 9.4ms
- p99: 42.3ms -> 34.6ms
- avg: 15.1ms -> 16.0ms
(basically p99 improved, avg increased slightly for large payloads)
Priya: small win. we should also add a KV coalescing pass: merge adjacent small KV fragments into a single allreduce when they map to contiguous indices. that should reduce message count and improve overlap.
Alex: +1. also check kernel selection: for small messages runtime sometimes picks a generic reduce kernel that does copy->reduce->copy. force a direct inplace reduce for <64KB.
Mateo: I'll run a sweep: algorithms=[ring,tree], chunk_sizes=[16KB,32KB,64KB,128KB], kernel_flags=[generic,direct] across microbatch sizes [1,2,4] to map the cliff and find stable thresholds.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolled out NCCL 2.13 to staging at 12:04 UTC (for later verification).
Jing: putting together a follow-up PR with perf plots, the heuristic diff, and a regression checklist. plan:
1) land algorithm switch heuristic
2) add KV coalesce optimization
3) add direct kernel path for small msgs
4) run automated A/B on dedicated pool and monitor per-route latency breakdowns
Mateo: I'll own the NCCL tuning runs and upload csv to the perf bucket.
Priya: once we have numbers, we should add an eval that exercises typical KV cache hotpath to catch regressions in CI.
Jing: thanks — opening the thread PR now. tagging @Mateo for the sweep and @Priya for KV coalesce design. short-term metric: reduce p99 by >=15% for small-msg microbatch workloads. longer term: reduce unit cost impact by improving coalescing so batching heuristics don't spike message counts. :rocket:
Mateo: noted. starting sweep now — will dump results to: https://perf.internal/redwood/tp-rendezvous-sweeps/1778882468
Alex: also log: `nvidia-smi dmon -s u -d 1` and `nvprof --csv` for the hottest steps to correlate GPU utilization.
Jing: thanks everyone. will post the PR link and perf plots in this thread when ready.
